items.title: 3 Hydrogen Stocks To Watch In November 2026
items.summary: Global power grids are being upgraded at record speed, with new transmission projects reported 50% higher last year. That surge in wires and substations needs cleaner, reliable sources to feed them, which puts hydrogen fuel cell technology on more investor watchlists. If you care about potential long term energy transition themes, this article walks through three hydrogen fuel cell stocks from our screener worth a closer look.
